body.purpose: Controls, lists, fields, and readable prose.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Menus and interactive desktop surfaces only.

motion.name: state

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action within a local decision area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #6B4E71; color: #FEFBF6; font: 600 14px/1.25 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #574265; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6B4E71; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #4A3B5C; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A persistent-label task field with visible focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #2D1F3D; font: 600 14px/1.25 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #E4D9C0; border-radius: 8px; background: #FEFBF6; color: #2D1F3D; font: 400 16px/1.5 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #B8A9C9; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6B4E71; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A familiar icon and label destination with a tonal active state.
components.html: Food Schedule
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #EBE7EF; color: #2D1F3D; text-decoration: none; font: 600 14px/1.25 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #D7CFE0; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6B4E71; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Food Tracker feels like a trusted household object made precise enough for daily planning. Warm paper-like surfaces and muted plum ink provide culinary character, while familiar controls keep recipes, schedules, and grocery work fast.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, restrained surfaces with one scarce action accent.
Culinary headings paired with highly legible task text.
Clear offline, pending, synced, and conflict states.
Familiar web and native controls with consistent nouns.

rules.name: The Scarce Plum Rule
rules.body: Mystic Action carries actions and state on no more than a small portion of a task screen.

rules.name: The Task Type Rule
rules.body: Any text the user must scan, compare, or operate uses the body family.

rules.name: The Flat Until Needed Rule
rules.body: If a border or background change communicates the layer, a shadow is forbidden.

dos: Do keep the next meal-planning or shopping action visible and concrete.
Do expose offline, pending, synced, and conflict states in plain language.
Do adapt dense desktop tables into touch-first lists, detail screens, and contextual actions.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS dashboards made from interchangeable nested cards and oversized summary metrics.
Don't use purple-gradient, glassmorphic AI interfaces that make ordinary actions feel theatrical.
Don't compress desktop tables onto a phone instead of adapting them to touch-first workflows.
